mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 1.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to expectations of reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 4.5% in a 3-month window, the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates broad-based demand weakness, which the market interprets as a recession signal, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When RSAFS < 480000 and HOUST < 1300, the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High industrial production growth (INDPRO > 105) reflects strong manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns during economic expansion periods over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods of economic expansion (INDPRO > 105), the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 250 indicates persistent inflation, which may trigger aggressive monetary tightening and lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL exceeds 250, the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market (high PAYEMS) supports consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days regardless of the broader economic cycle.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS is above 145000, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 1.5%) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 250) signals stagflation risk, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to loss of central bank credibility.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS < 1.5 and CPIAUCSL > 250, the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong consumer demand (RSAFS > 500000) during the early economic cycle supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In early-cycle expansion (RSAFS > 500000), the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.
